proposals: For camera zones with phantom tracks (319, 318, 296 here): a 'subtract_excess' or 'cap_symmetric' action that removes, slot by slot, the part of the count above a baseline taken from the same zone's normal days, where both directions rise together and no neighbouring zone does. This would keep the real bikes in the affected days instead of setting the whole day missing; the phantom bursts here sit on top of a normal profile and the real share is usually 10-30% of the day.

useful: zeros: showed the camera-wide outages at once, since all 15 directions share the same start and end
daily/slots pivots: exposed the symmetric phantom bursts on 319 and the overnight counts on 318/296
raw: confirmed the outage days are 'warning' records and the short dropouts are 'good' zeros
overview: 297's level collapse after June 2022 and the multi-month gaps
not_useful: spikes: flagged nothing because the 99.9th percentile of 319 is itself inflated by the phantoms and the bursts spread over many slots rather than one
doubled/duplicates/absent_zeros: nothing relevant for this camera
improve: spikes: use a robust baseline (e.g. median of the slot-of-day over workdays) and flag multi-hour runs, not single slots above a record-wide percentile
zeros: add an option to find stretches where the whole counter (all sites/directions) is 0 together, with the daytime share, which separates outages from quiet nights
add: A camera-wide view: per slot, the total across all zones plus which zones deviate, to tell a single-zone phantom from a real crowd that crosses several zones
A symmetry detector for a zone's two directions (both up together, ratio near 1) against its neighbours, since that is the signature of a jittering phantom track

summary: One camera (249) covers eight zones at Oxford St/Moore Park Rd/Lang Rd; its five camera-wide outages (Nov 2022, Mar-May 2023, Jun-Jul 2023, Sep 2024, Oct-Nov 2024) and several short dropouts are set missing. The Lang Rd LT crossing (319) is repeatedly swamped by symmetric phantom bursts (54 day ranges, ~159k false counts), and 318 and 296 have a few, all set missing. The 297 footpath recorded phantoms on its first two days and then fell about 20-fold on 21 Jun 2022, apparently a zone redefinition, so its series is split there.
